title: Taiwan eAIP AIP AMDT 01/24 airport data
publisher: Taiwan Civil Aviation Administration Aeronautical Information Service
license_note: Official aeronautical information publication; retained for personal research with source attribution.
relevant_locator: AD 2 airport pages; ARP coordinates and site at aerodrome
temporal_proof: AIP AMDT 01/24 was published on 2024-03-22, before the 2025-09-01 bookmark. Every normalized aerodrome point is extracted from a frozen page and protected by its own SHA256.
reliability_notes: Authoritative aeronautical information source. Aerodrome reference points identify airports but do not describe runway, terminal, capacity, ownership, military use, or target status.

title: Civil aviation transportation airport operations statistics, ROC year 113
license_note: Official government statistics; retained for personal research with source attribution.
relevant_locator: Monthly airport operating volumes for January through December 2024
temporal_proof: The ROC year 113 workbook was published on 2025-02-04. The normalized baseline admits only September through December 2024 from this source.
reliability_notes: Authoritative airport statistics. The observations measure civilian activity rather than physical capacity, readiness, military movement, or guaranteed service.

title: Civil aviation transportation airport operations statistics, ROC year 114
license_note: Official government statistics; retained for personal research with source attribution.
relevant_locator: Monthly airport operating volumes for January through December 2025
temporal_proof: The ROC year 114 workbook was published on 2026-01-26, after the opening bookmark. It is admitted only as retrospective research evidence for January through August 2025 and is never labeled contemporaneously available.
reliability_notes: Authoritative retrospective airport statistics. The observations may reconstruct opening utilization but may not initialize player knowledge that depended on postbookmark publication.
